correctness.rationale: For c>=0, Plancherel periodizes |g-hat_c|^2=(c^2+xi^2)exp(-2pi xi^2) into P_a=S_2+a S_0. S_2=S_0/(4pi)+S_0''/(16pi^2) and Chebyshev U-series yield S_0'<0 on (0,1/2), R=-S_2'/S_0'. Reconstructed numerator of dR/dz for z=cos(2pi x): the published uniform n>=3 tail bounds T_j and H,H',H'',H''' estimates imply a strictly positive lower bound >0.004, hence R decreases strictly in x, rather than merely on a test grid. This proves the unique interior maximum for a_-<a<a_+, endpoint maxima otherwise, a single endpoint minimum switch at the weighted mean a_*, and exact frequency multiplicities; P_a>0 ensures optimal Riesz bounds via Fejer localization. Independently evaluated the direct Gaussian sums/derivatives: a_-~=0.14253418288, a_*~=0.170429503114442, a_+~=0.19649740588 with ordered sampled R values. Finite sampling corroborates but does not prove monotonicity.
